Pregnant Woman Dies After Alleged Police Assault in UP, Six Officers Suspended

A pregnant woman died in Firozabad, Uttar Pradesh after an alleged police assault. Police are accused of kicking the woman, who was the wife of a suspect, inside a police station. A post‑mortem examination reported that the woman suffered a uterine rupture. Following the incident, six police officers were suspended pending investigation. Centrist outlets emphasized the alleged assault and disciplinary action, while a right‑leaning outlet highlighted the post‑mortem findings.
